_description: Session 109 verifier-robustness cells. We verify the 1-of-5 PROPOSER union once (per verifier temperature) at N iterations, then derive every proposer-vote input level (1of5..5of5) as a free post-hoc subset (the union geojson carries vote_count per feature) AND the verifier-determinism analysis (avg-of-N single runs vs an N-run consensus verifier). Stage 1 = T=0.0 only; later stages add 0.3/0.7/1.0 one notch at a time.
